{{Quote|I don't remember seeing ''this'' on the charts.''"<br />"''Because it wasn't&hellip; which doesn't makes sense. A structure this size would have lit up the scanners. It ''should'' be on the maps.|[[Syke (clone trooper)|Syke]] and [[Banks (clone)|Banks]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within">''[[The Clone Wars: The Enemy Within]]''</ref>}}
A '''map''' was a graphical representation of a given area so that individuals could navigate through unfamiliar terrain. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Seth Cambriel]] provided [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents with a [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] divers map to help them recover supplies from a submerged [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on [[Spira]].
